rubrics.justification: Core grading interpretation is reasonable for a 2AB blastocyst, but it adds image-specific findings like cytoplasmic granularity and a refractile body/vacuole that may be fabricated or not clearly verifiable from the image.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, sperm, endometrium, endometriosis, BMI, and lifestyle factors well with embryo quality and prognosis, though some links are somewhat overstated.
The structure is logical and the probability estimate generally follows the listed factors, but some deductions are speculative and the weighting of modifiers is not strongly evidence-based.

Much of the advice is broadly consistent with IVF practice, but recommendations such as ERA for endometriosis and PGT-A because endometriosis elevates aneuploidy risk are not strongly guideline-supported for this case.
Provides clear practical steps on smoking cessation, alcohol avoidance, luteal support, and future planning, though some suggestions are more optional/speculative than standard-of-care.
